theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h i
  let w : Fin 9 → ℤ := fun j => (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)
  obtain ⟨_, hd⟩ := (hrelation d e).mp h.1
  obtain ⟨_, he⟩ := (hrelation e f).mp h.2
  have rep (u v : Fin 9 → ℤ) (k : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = k then v j else u j) = digits_to_num u + (v k - u k) * w k := by
    rw [← add_comm, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
    simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Fintype.sum_ite_eq' k (fun j => (v j - u j) * w j)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    by_cases h : j = k
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, sub_mul]; rfl
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, sub_self]
  have h₂ : ∑ k, (digits_to_num d + (e k - d k) * w k)
      = 9 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_mul,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rfl
  have h₃ : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * w i := by
    rw [show (d i - f i) * w i = 9 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d)
          - 7 * digits_to_num d - (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * w i)
          - (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * w i) from by ring]
    exact ((h₂ ▸ Finset.dvd_sum fun k _ => (rep d e k) ▸ hd k).sub (dvd_mul_right 7 _)).sub
        ((rep d e i) ▸ hd i) |>.sub ((rep e f i) ▸ he i)
  exact (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩).pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right h₃
